name: Nojima Mayuko
source:
Mayuko is a first year student and [url=/c40768]Serizawa Sayoko[/url]'s classmate, who belongs to the photography club and newspaper club. She is good friends with [url=/c40771]Haneda Kumiko[/url] and a fan of the protagonist's novels.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=24048]Getchu[/url].]
